subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this remain the umbrella tracker for multi-agent orchestration stability while narrower fixes land, or should maintainers split it into narrower canonical issues and close the umbrella after linking them?
rationale: Current main has partial repairs, but the remaining work spans bug fixes and broader orchestration policy; automation cannot choose the permanent product boundary for subagent isolation, cancellation, and operator visibility.

options.title: Keep umbrella plus narrow fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open as the routing umbrella and review/land narrower fixes such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 before reassessing closure.

options.title: Split and close umbrella later
options.body: Promote one or more narrower canonical issues for the remaining root causes, link this evidence there, and close this issue only after the split is explicit.

options.title: Sponsor orchestration redesign
options.body: Treat this as a product-design effort for token-ring or metadata-only orchestration semantics rather than a bug sweep candidate.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella plus narrow fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the routing umbrella and review/land narrower fixes such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 before reassessing closure.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for subagent/session-lock architecture and current vision boundaries points to steipete.
